opening.argument: The video presents a crypto-arbitrage auto-trading service alongside a specific daily profit claim. Its title promises “Profit $60 daily crypto arbitrage trading bots,” while the speaker directs viewers to “Click on run auto trading and wait for your profit.” The operational instructions are concrete: viewers are told they can link exchanges to the platform through APIs, set up at least two connections, and configure the trading settings. The dashboard reinforces that solicitation with API and secret-key fields, trading controls, and a RUN AUTO TRADING button, while displaying session and total-profit panels. Although the description calls the video educational, disclaims financial advice, and advises further research, that language remains alongside instructions to use automated trading to generate income. The dashboard does not show a realized gain, so the evidence does not establish a particular outcome, but it does establish an income-oriented automated-trading offer with material account-access requirements.
